title: Amazing sunset views!
text: We did the Sunset Bike tour in Grenada and we would highly recommend it.  The views are amazing and it was a lot of fun.  Ruth, our guide, was excellent and really nice.   She even gave us nice restaurants recommendations at the end.

title: Amazing views, thanks Ruben!
text: Brilliant ebike tour up to some viewpoints with epic views over the city and the Alhambra itself! Guide Ruben was brilliant. He had lots of interesting info, is clearly very passionate about the city, and we felt safe in his hands.

title: Wonderful E-bike tour of Granada
text: Fares was an amazing guide for our E-bike tour of Granada at sunset. He was very engaging and took us on a wonderful evening tour. We got to see some great views of the city and a beautiful sunset!
author: 345valeriet

title: Perfect way to experience the sunset and mountains in Granada
text: I accidentally booked my tour on the wrong day and I was absolutely gutted because I thought that I wouldn’t be able to change the dates. The company were very understanding and allowed me to change it to a different day. I was led by Fares who was an excellent tour guide. He was very friendly and helpful throughout the tour and made good conversations. He also took pictures and videos of me riding the bike which were great for memories! I definitely recommend the sunset tour because you get to experience beautiful viewpoints from the mountains whilst catching the sunset and having fun in the
